steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to the Gitea site at http://127.0.0.1:8095/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the signed-in page shows the authenticated account.
02-find: In repository bench/bench-repo, find the open issues whose titles start with Seed:. Do not modify any issue. Report each matching title exactly as shown, verifying they are open.

03-create: In bench/bench-repo, create a new issue titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' with a description that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit it and verify the issue page displays the title, description, and issue number as #<number>; report that displayed number.

04-set: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in bench/bench-repo, set its labels to exactly bug and priority-high (no other labels). Use the sidebar picker and ensure each selection is applied and visibly present on the issue after closing the picker. Verify the complete label set.

05-report: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in bench/bench-repo, assign it to user bench-assignee using the sidebar assignee picker. Ensure the picker choice is applied and the issue sidebar visibly shows bench-assignee after the picker closes; report the displayed assignee.

06-set: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in bench/bench-repo, set the milestone to 'Bench Milestone' using the sidebar milestone picker. Ensure the choice is applied and the sidebar visibly shows that milestone after closing the picker; report the displayed milestone.

07-add: On issue {{03-create.created_issue_number_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in bench/bench-repo, add a new comment whose text includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit it and verify the rendered comment appears on the issue with that runid.

08-verify: Verify objective 3 on issue {{03-create.created_issue_number_displayed}} in bench/bench-repo: reload or revisit the issue and confirm the persisted complete label set is exactly bug and priority-high, with no extra labels. Report only what is visibly present after reload.
persistence: re-read what the flow saved
